      "text": "You need to place the `.dll` file into the **`rulesets`** folder inside your osu!lazer data directory.\n\nHere is the easiest way to do it:\n\n1.  **Open osu!lazer.**\n2.  Open the **Settings** (press `Ctrl` + `O` or click the gear icon).\n3.  In the **General** tab, click the button that says **Open osu! folder**.\n4.  In the folder that opens, look for a sub-folder named **`rulesets`**.\n    *   *If this folder does not exist, create a new folder and name it `rulesets`.*\n5.  **Paste the `osu.Game.Rulesets.Touhosu.dll` file** into this `rulesets` folder.\n6.  **Restart osu!lazer.**\n\nAfter restarting, you should see \"Touhosu\" appear in the ruleset/mode selection menu at the top of the screen.\n\n### Alternative Manual Paths\nIf you cannot open the game, you can navigate to the folder directly using your file explorer:\n\n*   **Windows:** `%AppData%\\osu\\rulesets`\n*   **macOS / Linux:** `~/.local/share/osu/rulesets`\n\n**Note:** If you are on Windows and the ruleset doesn\u0027t appear after restarting, right-click the `.dll` file, go to **Properties**, check **Unblock** at the bottom, and click OK.",

        "text": "You need to place the `.dll` file into the **`rulesets`** folder inside your osu!lazer data directory.\n\nHere is the easiest way to do it"
      }, {
        "text": ":\n\n1.  **Open osu!lazer.**\n2.  Open the **Settings** (press "
      }, {
        "text": "`Ctrl` + `O` or click the gear icon).\n3.  In the **General** tab, click"
      }, {
        "text": " the button that says **Open osu! folder**.\n4.  In the folder that opens, look for a sub-"
      }, {
        "text": "folder named **`rulesets`**.\n    *   *If this folder does not exist, create a new folder and"
      }, {
        "text": " name it `rulesets`.*\n5.  **Paste the `osu.Game.Rulesets.Touhosu."
      }, {
        "text": "dll` file** into this `rulesets` folder.\n6.  **Restart osu!lazer.**\n\nAfter"
      }, {
        "text": " restarting, you should see \"Touhosu\" appear in the ruleset/mode selection menu at the top of the screen."
      }, {
        "text": "\n\n### Alternative Manual Paths\nIf you cannot open the game, you can navigate to the folder directly using your file explorer:\n\n"
      }, {
        "text": "*   **Windows:** `%AppData%\\osu\\rulesets`\n*   **macOS / Linux:** `~/.local/"
      }, {
        "text": "share/osu/rulesets`\n\n**Note:** If you are on Windows and the ruleset doesn\u0027t appear after"
      }, {
        "text": " restarting, right-click the `.dll` file, go to **Properties**, check **Unblock** at the bottom,"
      }, {
        "text": " and click OK."
